scoring_justification: Full recomputation of grain-boundary energies from raw simulation artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox due to the heavy computational cost of EAM lattice statics. Scoring instead uses a result-level comparison of reported energies against paper-based gold values (±0.1 J/m² tolerance) combined with a structural audit of the energy–misorientation curve (convexity and cusp presence).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold grain-boundary energies for the 13 test boundaries, extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5A and the paper text for Σ13 (0.96 J/m²).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values digitised from the paper’s reported virtual-screening results and used as the reference oracle in solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual quantities the paper reports for the virtual screening prediction; they are the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Grain-boundary energies for the 13 test boundaries, obtained after virtual screening and a single relaxation. The checker compares these values to hidden reference energies from the paper and performs a structural audit on the energy vs misorientation curve (convex shape and cusps at characteristic angles).

output_contract.notes: The checker also verifies that the reported energies produce a convex profile with cusps at misorientation angles 16.26°, 28.07°, 36.87°, 53.13°, 67.38° within ±1°, but these structural constraints are encoded in the scoring logic and do not require an additional output file.
